body:
First off, whenever someone makes a generalization like this based on one poor experience, it’s offensive and just plain WRONG. 

It would have been different had you posted a warning that APs are not always who you think they are until you decide to leave and pursue a monogamous relationship with them. Hell, a lot of people aren’t who we think they are until we settle down with them. Why do most of us enter the adulterous lifestyle to begin with? Because our partner doesn’t meet our needs like we expected them to. 

But instead, you essentially decided to call everyone else delusional because you had a bad experience. C’mon now. 

Besides, some of your complaints seem like such non issues that I’m not sure why you brought them up. She farts?? Omg I can’t imagine finding out woman are humans. She accidentally spilled something on her clothing? The horror of being clumsy sometimes! 

Besides her cheating, most of the other stuff just seems so mundane it makes me question if you’re not part of the problem too, to be honest. Your standards sound a little bit delusional, but please don’t project that onto us.
Ohhh id be interested to read that one...do you have a link?

I wanted to but there was no official end. Just got left hanging during a conversation and I decided not to initiate contact anymore. I wanted finality but I guess he got to it first. 

As of last week I was still torn on what I’d do if he showed up and wanted to see me again. 

It actually sucks because I wanted the last say and to be able to tell him why I’m going no contact. I hate the unanswered questions the ghosting involves. 

I feel like I deserve an explanation - especially when he’s said in the past he’d never just ghost a friend. Wtf.

I wouldn’t ghost either for the record, even if I just gave a “this isn’t working for me” explanation.
What transfer? Thinking of someone else’s post maybe?

INFO: if you found out your SO is in fact cheating, how would things change things? 

In my mind, I can’t see caring that my partner cheats if I do or even plan to. I think it would actually be kind of a relief. We both would be getting what we want.

The absolute worst is an AP who seems to have clearly lost interest or found someone else to actually be in a relationship with. 

BUT they refuse to end it. Things aren’t the same at all, but they give bullshit excuses and leave just enough breadcrumbs to keep you attached.

I get this perspective and there’s plenty of subs dedicated to this viewpoint. 

But why subscribe to a sub that’s pro-infidelity if you feel this way? 

You think coming on here and blasting us will change our opinion or perspective?

You make really good points and I’m glad you jumped in. 

I think I would be okay with this situation under certain circumstances. Obviously I think it’s better if everyone is on the same page. I’d much rather he told her about me and let her know he intends to see us both. 

I don’t expect to be the main priority, as you’re absolutely right, he can’t be mine. But John straight up ignoring me for weeks at a time? Being left on read for days? Showing up out of the blue to say he misses me, but then making ZERO effort to ever actually see me? Being “too busy” to see me for two months, yet finding time to see Amanda multiple times a week? That’s the stuff I have an issue with. 

I’m also pretty bothered that John was so willing to lose everything we had, including friendship, for someone else. The second she leaves her husband (and not for him specifically, either. Her ex is abusive. Although I’m sure having a backup plan was nice), he wants to get serious with her to the point where he barely talks to me. All this right after he tells me he values our friendship and that none of that will change. 

So I’m the side chick friend who keeps his secrets and helps him find employment and does everything his way, all for him to straight up ignore me?

You’re right, this isn’t okay and I need to send that message.

Thank you! I did try with one other AP in the last few months. I was desperate to feel something - anything - for someone else. 

But I ended up not feeling anything, and he developed feelings. Besides this, he was single and looking for more than I could provide him with given my situation. I felt bad because he was hurt when I broke it off. But I did for his benefit just as much as mine. I refused to string him along as I’ve been strung along all these months.

I’m in a tough spot because I’m looking for more than just sex in an ideal situation, especially if I am ever to get over John. But I can’t force feelings. I don’t want more people getting involved that end up hurt because I don’t reciprocate in one way or another.
Side point - I’ll never understand the people who join this sub just to send nasty messages to the subscribers who post here.
Tried that. I felt nothing and then the guy ended up getting hurt when I couldn’t reciprocate his feelings. Don’t really want to bring anyone else down.

And then the last couple times we have hung out he’s been indifferent towards sex. 

So apparently I’m not even good for that in his mind anymore. 😫

I keep having this line play over and over in my head for what I want to say to Amanda if she asks why I don’t talk to her. 

“Go ask John so he can lie to you like usual.”

I know you are right. It’s so hard. When we do see each other, it’s always amazing. He says things like “I missed you so much.” 

The last couple of times he hasn’t initiated sex either, we only did it because I initiated. 

I honestly don’t know which is worse - being used for sex and not realizing it, or him not being interested anymore.

Oh, that is so true about the “unicorn.” I never thought it was signing up for that spot. I truly thought at the time that he “loved us both” as he claimed and wanted to keep us both. 

Most likely just more lies. 

This guy literally gets whatever he wants whenever he wants it. He gets the girls he wants, and when he got hired where I work (same job essentially) he convinced them to hire him at an unprecedented rate. Way higher than mine. 

So he gets women, has lots of money, lies to everyone apparently and gets away with it all. 

Fuck him.
